verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a search bar and a query system (`{{query ...}}` simple queries, `/query`, and date-range `between` filters on journal pages), and its local-first, per-graph local-only design implies the search works offline. Instant retrieval is undercut by community reports that indexing and responsiveness slow down massively on large graphs, and queries are described as hard to learn and poorly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of full-text search behavior, documented filters on tags, properties and paths, explicit offline search confirmation, and evidence of instant performance at scale.
